hooks.text: 远征归来升级城镇、附魔装备并持续塑造角色打法
hooks.excerpt: Return from your expeditions to upgrade your town, enchant gear, and unlock new upgrades for your character. Build a thriving hub to support your adventures and shape your play style in countless ways.
